__meta__.purpose: Reusable LongBench eval-set sizes for HYP-055+ KV-quant experiments.

task_timing_qwen3_8b_a100.gov_report: fp16 ~20s/sample | A ~20s | B ~400s | ctx ~11-17k, long outputs

budget_notes: B (PolarQuant 1b + QJL 1b) runs Python-dense d×d matmul on every attention step.
B wall-clock ≈ 30-40× fp16/A until a CUDA kernel ships.
Pick the smallest preset that still distinguishes methods by > 1.5 pt.

tiny_fast_qa.description: ~1 min fp16/A, ~12 min B — smallest useful smoke for B.

small_balanced.description: ~3 min fp16/A, ~35 min B — first signal check for a method change.

medium_mix.description: ~8 min fp16/A, ~90 min B — near-confident ranking before full.

full.description: ~15 min fp16/A, ~3 hr B — definitive, HYP-055 primary run.

short_ctx_only.description: Only samples with context < 8 k tokens. Tests whether quant damage is present at short ctx.

long_ctx_only.description: Only samples with context ≥ 16 k. Isolates long-ctx quant failure modes.

qa_only_fast.description: QA tasks only (qasper, hotpotqa) — fastest path to B's quality signal, skip summarization.
